_what_this_is: THE PROGRAMME OF STUDY, IN FLIGHT. This file exists because the study's
PURPOSE kept being lost: the simulated runs were repeatedly described by
their success criterion (3 clean convergences) rather than by why they are
run at all. The founder had to point this out on 2026-10-03, and he was
substantially right -- arms 1 to 4 had each run twice, arm 5 had NEVER run,
and arm 5 is the only one that answers the effectiveness question.
A UserPromptSubmit hook reads this file EVERY TURN and injects a 1-line
reminder naming what is still outstanding. A compaction discards the
conversation; it does not discard this file. The reminder STOPS by itself
when every measurement carries a result and a headline -- `status` goes to
CLOSED -- so the mechanism expires rather than nagging forever.
rationale: To measure whether the fixes of the last 15+ days actually WORK. Clean convergence is the success CRITERION of the runs, NOT their purpose.
closes_when: every measurement below has result != null AND headline != null; then set status to CLOSED and the hook falls silent

measurements.what: Paired baseline: pre-window a2a0197 vs HEAD, same target, same seed. THE effectiveness question.
Declared state vs observed state: does what the launcher declares match what fires? No committed script exists.
Haiku as the decidable-claim classifier at run scale, and the founder's confidence composition (Haiku decides, syntax raises confidence, never blocks).
measurements.founder_ruling: DO IT, mark as a significant study area (2026-10-03)

measurements.what: Make the false-positive sweep able to see refused falsifiers. Measured: 23 of 221 routed bodies invisible, 183 truncated at 600 chars.
measurements.founder_ruling: RUN IT, mark as a significant study area (2026-10-03)

measurements.what: attempt_close asks whether a fix BROKE anything, never whether it CURED the defect: 126 of 246 = 51.2195%, Wilson [45.0027%, 57.3989%]. Measure the cost of promoting the probe from record to veto.
The repointing experiment: 2 arms, A replays unedited to control for archive decay, B repoints at a different target. Settles over-specificity.
measurements.founder_ruling: RUN IT, record results, implement useful findings (2026-10-03)
